info.name: Ecom Service
info.description:
The ecom service (port 8083): the provider statement read from the TXPG gateway database (read-only), the home page summary and the provider terminal directory. Contract - project_docs/modules/ecom.md.

Every request needs a JWT: run Login in auth/Auth.postman_collection.json and put its `authToken` into this collection's `authToken` variable (or keep `authToken` in a Postman environment - an environment value overrides the collection one). The access token lives 15 minutes.

Statement and summary requests take the period from `dateFrom` / `dateTo`; left empty, the collection pre-request script uses the last 7 days. Every statement request is a query against the live gateway database - keep periods short.

exec: // Keeps the next page cursor and the first order of the page for the requests below.

query.description: Required. ISO-8601 instant, inclusive; orders are taken by their creation time. Empty variable - 7 days ago (collection pre-request script).
Required. ISO-8601 instant, exclusive, after dateFrom; the period may not exceed ecom.txpg.max-window (92 days). Empty variable - now.
Optional. Provider merchant rids (merchantRid from List Statement Merchants); repeat the parameter or separate by commas. Only narrows the caller's scope.
Optional. Lower bound of the order amount, inclusive.
Optional. Upper bound of the order amount, inclusive.
Optional. Exact match: order number, ridByMerchant or RRN.

Optional. PENDING, AUTHORIZED, SUCCESS, PARTIALLY_PAID, FAILED, PARTIALLY_REFUNDED, REFUNDED or CANCELED, exactly. Filtered after the orders are assembled: a page may come shorter than size, even empty, with a cursor.
Optional. SMS or DMS, exactly; anything else - 400.
Optional. nextCursor of the previous page (saved to the cursor variable by the test script). Enable to get the next page.
Optional. Page size, default 25, clamped to 1..ecom.txpg.max-page-size (200).

request.description:
The provider statement (ecom.md §2.4): one row per order with its whole operation history, newest order first, cursor pagination (`nextCursor`, null on the last page). Scope - the merchants of the caller's company multimerchant login; SYSTEM_ADMIN and AUDITOR - of all companies. A role without a company - 403. The `test` script saves `nextCursor` to `cursor` and the first order to `orderId`.

400: a missing or malformed dateFrom/dateTo, dateTo not after dateFrom, a period longer than 92 days, an unknown status or paymentType, an unreadable cursor. With nothing in scope the answer is an empty page.

query.description: Required. ISO-8601 instant, inclusive; orders are taken by their creation time. Empty variable - 7 days ago (collection pre-request script).
Required. ISO-8601 instant, exclusive, after dateFrom; the period may not exceed ecom.txpg.max-window (92 days). Empty variable - now.
Optional. Provider merchant rids (merchantRid from List Statement Merchants); repeat the parameter or separate by commas. Only narrows the caller's scope.
Optional. SMS or DMS, exactly; anything else - 400.

request.description: Totals over every order of the period, not over a loaded page (ecom.md §2.5): order count, counts per status (all eight, zeros included) and captured and refunded amounts per currency. Same period, merchant and payment type rules as List Statement; no amount, search, status or cursor filters.

The merchants of the caller's scope - the source of the merchantRids filter (ecom.md §2.6). Read from the portal database, the gateway is not queried. Each row: merchantRid, title, login and terminalRid from the provider terminal directory; a merchant missing there has only a title.

One order with its whole history - the same object as a statement row (ecom.md §2.7); no period needed. `{{orderId}}` is set by List Statement. 404 when the order does not exist, belongs to another company, is not finished or the number is not numeric - the four cases are indistinguishable on purpose.

Refunds a statement order (ecom.md §2.7a, Р-125): up to actions.refund.maxAmount of the order card; SYSTEM_ADMIN, COMPANY_HEAD, COMPANY_MANAGER within the company's merchants. A disabled button is the same refusal and never reaches the provider. 409 for an order the portal created - refund its portal transaction instead.
Captures the hold of a DMS statement order (ecom.md §2.7a, Р-125): up to actions.capture.maxAmount; every role except AUDITOR.

SYSTEM_ADMIN only (ecom.md §2.7b, Р-125): records the outcome of a refund or capture the provider did not confirm, after reconciling it with the provider. Lifts the lock; nothing is recorded locally - the money is in the statement. Returns the order card.

query.description: Required. ISO-8601 instant, inclusive; orders are taken by their creation time. Empty variable - 7 days ago (collection pre-request script).
Required. ISO-8601 instant, exclusive, after dateFrom; the period may not exceed ecom.txpg.max-window (92 days). Empty variable - now.

request.description: The portal home page summary (ecom.md §2.8): card payments of every merchant in the caller's scope over the period - totals per currency, counts per status, daily totals in ECOM_TXPG_ZONE and the top five terminals per currency. Same orders and money rules as the statement. dateFrom and dateTo are required, up to 92 days; with nothing in scope the answer is zeros and the gateway is not queried.

query.description: Optional, default false. true also returns terminals switched off at the provider (in no particular order).

request.description: SYSTEM_ADMIN only (ecom.md §3.1): the snapshot of provider terminals from the portal database, one row per merchant - rid (merchant.rid), title, login, terminalRid, active, lastSeenAt. Active rows are ordered by title. Other roles - 403.

SYSTEM_ADMIN only (ecom.md §3.2). Refreshes both snapshots - provider terminals and multimerchant logins - now, without waiting for the schedule (every 15 minutes). No body. The top-level fields describe the terminal snapshot, `logins` - the login snapshot; `applied: false` with `skippedBecause` means the snapshot was left untouched (gateway unavailable, query failed or an empty response). Other roles - 403.

exec: // Empty dateFrom / dateTo: the last 7 days up to now, for this request only; values set by hand win.

variable.description: The base URL for the ecom service.
JWT access token from POST /api/v1/auth/login (Login in the Auth collection, its authToken variable). Lives 15 minutes.
Start of the period, ISO-8601 instant (e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z). Empty - 7 days ago.
End of the period, exclusive, ISO-8601 instant. Empty - now.
nextCursor of the last statement page, set by 'List Statement'.
The provider order number, set by 'List Statement' (the first order of the page).
